note: Labeled attachment-retrieval tasks: a query, a shortlist of passages, and the ids that answer it. The shortlist has no order here; the baseline order comes from the ranker named in the report (a lexical TF-IDF proxy unless a recorded Flint embedding order is supplied with --baseline-order).

tasks.query: How long do customers have to return an item?

passages.r1: Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are unused.
passages.r2: Returns shipping labels are emailed after you open a request in your account.
passages.r3: Our customer service team is available on weekdays from 9 to 5.
passages.r4: Customers who return frequently may be asked to verify their identity.
passages.r5: Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash.
passages.r6: Delivery usually takes three to five business days.

tasks.query: What is the maximum upload size?

passages.u1: Uploads are scanned for malware before they are stored.
passages.u2: A single file may not exceed 250 MB; larger files must be split.
passages.u3: The upload button is at the top right of the workspace.
passages.u4: Maximum team size on the free plan is five members.
passages.u5: Supported upload formats include PDF, DOCX and PNG.
passages.u6: Upload history is kept for 90 days.

passages.e1: Expense reports must include itemized receipts.
passages.e2: Reports are reimbursed in the next payroll cycle.
passages.e3: Any claim above five thousand dollars needs sign-off from the finance director.
passages.e4: Managers approve expense reports for their direct reports.
passages.e5: Travel expenses should be booked through the corporate portal.
passages.e6: Report fraud to the compliance hotline.

tasks.query: How do I rotate the API key?

passages.k1: API keys are scoped to a single project.
passages.k2: Never commit an API key to version control.
passages.k3: The API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per key.
passages.k4: To replace a credential, open Settings > Security, create a new key, update your clients, then revoke the old one.
passages.k5: Keys can be given read-only or read-write permissions.
passages.k6: Contact support if you lose access to your account.

tasks.query: Is the office open on public holidays?

passages.h1: The office is open Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.
passages.h2: We close on national bank holidays; the building remains locked.
passages.h3: Holiday requests should be submitted two weeks in advance.
passages.h4: Public transport to the office runs every ten minutes.
passages.h5: The office kitchen is cleaned daily.
passages.h6: Visitors must sign in at reception.

tasks.query: What happens if a payment fails?

passages.p1: We accept Visa, Mastercard and bank transfer.
passages.p2: Payments are processed in US dollars.
passages.p3: Invoices are issued on the first day of each month.
passages.p4: A payment receipt is emailed after every successful charge.
passages.p5: If a charge is declined we retry after three days and suspend the account after two further attempts.
passages.p6: Payment details can be updated in the billing page.

tasks.query: Can I bring my dog to work?

passages.d1: Work from home is allowed two days per week.
passages.d2: Service animals are always welcome in public areas.
passages.d3: Pets, including dogs, are permitted on the third floor only, on Fridays.
passages.d4: Bring your laptop charger; spares are limited.
passages.d5: The dog park near the office closes at dusk.
passages.d6: Allergies should be reported to HR.

tasks.query: How is data encrypted at rest?

passages.x1: Data in transit is protected with TLS 1.3.
passages.x2: Stored data is protected with AES-256, with keys held in a hardware security module.
passages.x3: We retain data for seven years.
passages.x4: Customers can export their data at any time.
passages.x5: Rest periods for on-call staff are scheduled weekly.
passages.x6: Encryption keys for backups are rotated yearly.

tasks.query: What is the notice period for resignation?

passages.n1: Resignation letters should be addressed to your manager.
passages.n2: Unused leave is paid out on your final payslip.
passages.n4: Employees must give four weeks' written notice before leaving; eight weeks for senior staff.
passages.n5: Notice boards are located by the lifts.

tasks.query: Does the plan include phone support?

passages.s2: Support tickets are answered within one business day.
passages.s3: Phone numbers can be added to your profile.
passages.s4: The enterprise plan adds single sign-on.
passages.s5: Plans are billed annually or monthly.
passages.s6: Calling our help line is available on Business and Enterprise tiers only.
